FM-1_989: SCREEN RATE setting (10, 15, 20 or 30 pictures a second on the FM-1 and the page). FM-1_988: the screen above Effects keeps up with the FM-1 (rows sent back to back); the line under it shows both picture rates. FM-1_987: the screen above Effects without torn panels, up to 30 times a second over USB; Read from my FM-1 connects by itself. FM-1_986: cursor-following effects on more LSDj versions (9.3.9 with custom palettes or kits: everything; 9.4.0, 9.2.L, 9.1.C, 8.4.9, 8.4.2, 4.6.2: cursor effects and LFO tempo). FM-1_985: the screen above Effects updates several times faster over USB. FM-1_984: two effects areas: a knob or SELECT pops up the channel pages (FILTER .. LO-FI) for the channel under the cursor; the FX button opens / closes the master pages (MASTER, ECHO, ECHO MOD; C4-F4 mute). FM-1_983: the web page shows the FM-1's screen above Effects (view only). FM-1_982: FX opens the channel pages (FILTER .. LO-FI), FX again the master pages (MASTER, ECHO, ECHO MOD; C4-F4 mute), FX again closes; SELECT stays within the list. FM-1_981: autosave (every minute at most by default, without stopping the music); the battery as 3/3 .. 0/3 or USB. FM-1_980: MASTER K3 / K4 echo mix and time; FX THEME under THEME; a long knob turn opening a settings page no longer changes its first setting. FM-1_979: echo send on FILTER K2; SELECT stops at the first and last FX page; muted channels grey with the reason; MIDI CC changes shown, CC out; FX+LIGHTS switches (knobs as channels, black-key page lights, HOME light sweep, battery, FX panel theme). Tap FX for the channel and echo pages; C4-F4 mute with FX held. Every LSDj 9.3.9 helper is enabled for this verified program fingerprint (including sample-kit variants): SEQ live/song mode, EDIT tempo, ARP song cues, MIDI clock/KEYBD sync, PLAY beat light and cursor-following effects. The template is experimental.
